mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month moving averages fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the tight labor market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC for low unemployment regime < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.2 million units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1.2, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals a stable monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-employment growth regime (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the expanding labor force supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high employment growth regime (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC for high employment growth regime < 0.05 over 3-year window.
